title: Make your bed
shortDescription: A simple morning chore that helps kids start the day with a tidy room.
body:
Pull up the sheets and blanket, smooth the top, and place pillows at the head of the bed.

Keep the task age-appropriate by focusing on completion rather than perfection.
seoTitle: Make Your Bed Chore for Kids
seoDescription: Use this age-appropriate make your bed chore idea to build a simple morning routine for kids.

title: Feed the pet
shortDescription: A supervised family chore for helping with pet care at mealtime.
body:
Check with a parent first, measure the approved amount of food, and place it in the pet's bowl.

Children should not handle medication, outdoor pet care, or unfamiliar animals.
seoTitle: Feed the Pet Chore for Kids
seoDescription: A safe, supervised feed the pet chore idea for families using kid-friendly routines.

title: Put laundry away
shortDescription: A practical chore that helps kids take ownership of clean clothes.
body: Sort clean clothes by type, fold or stack them, and place them in the right drawer or closet area.
seoTitle: Put Laundry Away Chore for Kids
seoDescription: Help kids learn responsibility with a simple put laundry away chore routine.

title: Movie night
shortDescription: A family reward idea where kids can earn a special movie night.
body: Let the child pick an approved family movie, choose a snack, and enjoy a relaxed reward together.
seoDescription: Use movie night as a simple family reward kids can earn by completing chores.

title: Extra screen time
shortDescription: A parent-configured reward for a small amount of extra approved screen time.
body: Set a clear time limit and content boundary before the reward is claimed.
seoDescription: A simple extra screen time reward idea with parent-set boundaries.

title: Age-appropriate chores for kids
shortDescription: A starter guide for choosing safe, useful chores by age and ability.
body:
Start with short, visible tasks and increase responsibility gradually.

Younger kids can tidy toys, make beds, or put laundry in a hamper. Older kids can help with dishes, folding laundry, or simple room resets. Avoid chores involving heat, sharp tools, harsh chemicals, heights, or unsafe outdoor work unless directly supervised by an adult.
seoDescription: Choose safe, age-appropriate chores for kids with this starter guide for family routines.
